Include the thread URL so future iterations can use the `read_thread` tool to reference previous work if needed.

The learnings section is critical - it helps future iterations avoid repeating mistakes and understand the codebase better.
spans.note: The prompt emphasizes accurate progress tracking, documenting what was actually implemented, recording learnings and gotchas, and maintaining honest records. The progress log format requires truthful documentation of changes, files modified, and patterns discovered.
